name: ContMDiffOn.coordChange
statement: ContMDiffOn IM IB n f s) (hg : ContMDiffOn IM 𝓘(𝕜, F) n g s) (he : MapsTo f s e.baseSet) (he' : MapsTo f s e'.baseSet) : ContMDiffOn IM 𝓘(𝕜, F) n (fun y ↦ e.coordChange e' (f y) (g y)) s

name: contMDiffOn
statement: Trivialization F (π F E)) [MemTrivializationAtlas e] : ContMDiffOn (IB.prod 𝓘(𝕜, F)) (IB.prod 𝓘(𝕜, F)) n e e.source

have_tree.type: ContMDiffOn (IB.prod 𝓘(𝕜, F)) (IB.prod 𝓘(𝕜, F)) n id e.source

name: contMDiffOn_section_iff
statement: ∀ x, E x} {a : Set B} (e : Trivialization F (Bundle.TotalSpace.proj : Bundle.TotalSpace F E → B)) [MemTrivializationAtlas e] (ha : IsOpen a) (ha' : a ⊆ e.baseSet) : ContMDiffOn IB (IB.prod 𝓘(𝕜, F)) n (fun x ↦ TotalSpace.mk' F x (s x)) a ↔ ContMDiffOn IB 𝓘(𝕜, F) n (fun x ↦ (e ⟨x, s x⟩).2) a
